label_contract.downsampling: label is drawn directly on 64x64 grid; no evaluator resampling

contract_check: PASS: logits returned; exactly one sigmoid; eval/no_grad; aligned 64x64 target/output
interpretation: F1=0 at threshold 0.3 means no thresholded hits. It does not mean raw logits or probabilities are identically zero; AUPRC and probability distributions retain ranking information.
threshold_policy: 0.3 remains the causal comparison threshold. Per-run optimal thresholds are diagnostic only and are not used to claim improvements.
